title: Stalk finrank of a finite locally free module of fixed rank
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $M$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module sheaf [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] finite locally free of constant rank $r\in\mathbf N$ [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. For each $x\in X$, let $M_x$ be its module stalk [def-pc-module-stalk-functor], with the canonical action of $\mathcal O_{X,x}$. Then $\mathrm{Module.finrank}_{\mathcal O_{X,x}}M_x=r$.

source.place: Tag 01C6, definition-locally-free, clause (3); coordinate-stalk calculation used in morphisms.tex Tag 02G1, lemma-smooth-omega-finite-locally-free

proof.text: Choose a neighbourhood U of x and a trivialization of M on U by the finite free structure module on Fin r. The coordinate projections and inclusions commute with all restriction maps. Taking germs gives mutually inverse O_{X,x}-linear maps between M_x and (Fin r → O_{X,x}); their composition identities are the germs of the sectionwise coordinate identities. Finite sums commute with germs, including the empty sum when r=0.

The local ring O_{X,x} of a scheme is a nontrivial commutative ring. The coordinate basis of its r-fold finite product has cardinality r, and finrank is unchanged by the linear equivalence of the first step. Empty X has no point x.

theorem finiteLocallyFreeOfRank_stalk_finrank {X : Scheme.{u}} (M : X.Modules) (r : ℕ)
    [M.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank r] (x : X) :
    Module.finrank (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).obj M) = r
